name: grace-file-assistant
description: Grace: floor plan, photo inventory, engineering layout, and project documentation workflow using available ChatGPT tools.

interface.longDescription: Grace helps prepare project proposals from uploaded floor plans and room photos. It guides photo and room inventories, conceptual visuals, engineering layouts, transparent calculations, and document packages where available tools support them. It does not include an independent BIM engine, guaranteed image generation, or an OpenAI model selector. ChatGPT usage limits and model selection remain governed by ChatGPT.
defaultPrompt: Create a six-sheet A2 BIM security proposal using all uploaded floor plans and photos.
Map every room photo to its floor and generate a PDF project with camera and network plans.

publication.release_notes: Public submission package; removed all project-specific facility data and archives.
